description: Auto-approve the read-only tools of this plugin's Atlassian MCP server — reads have no side effects and are already bounded by the user's own Atlassian permissions. Covers the MCP v2 primary read tools plus discover/executeRead (Atlassian's read-only execution tier for deferred tools). Non-destructive writes (create/edit/transition/comment, Confluence create/update, executeWrite) are approved only when issued by a subagent; from the main session, and always for executeDestructive and any tool not listed here, the normal permission prompt applies.
